name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: A plugin that gives AI coding assistants like Claude Code a memory, so they remember what you discussed and decided in past sessions instead of starting from scratch every time.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team heavily using Claude Code or Cursor daily who is tired of re-explaining project context every session.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it so client project context persists across weeks of work without re-pasting specs each session.
A dev tooling company bundles a hosted, team-shared version of it so a whole engineering team's agents share institutional memory.
An AI consulting shop uses it to speed up onboarding new coding agents to legacy codebases by letting memory accumulate over repeated sessions.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted managed-memory tier (the project already references 'CMEM Pro') with higher limits and team-sharing.
Sell a one-time 'memory migration' service that seeds a new agent's memory from a team's existing docs and chat history.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple team dashboard that visualizes what an agent 'remembers' about a project, as a paid add-on to this open-source core.
